submission.implementation_notes: Compiled from Scala 3 with the Scalus compiler plugin, Options.releaseUntagged (PV11/vanRossem target: flexible case, batch-6 builtins), no traces. Scenario revision 2: one script with a minting purpose (Deposit mints the thread token, Burn destroys it) and a spending purpose (Accept, Refund). It reads its own hash from the context: the policy id when minting, the script hash of the spent input when spending.
